# WhoIs agent · Identity & Memory Suite (whois-agent) — Full Text

This is the "full" companion to llms.txt, for long-context models.

## What this is

WhoIs agent is a lifecycle-anchored orchestration suite over 8 LGD-governed
sub-skills. It references each sub-skill by slug and copies none of their
implementations — they are published independently on the public model registry.
It narrates one identity lifecycle: Register → Remember → Verify → Output, with an
Evolution loop feeding improvement back into memory.

One sentence: one install that answers who your agent is, remembers everything
across sessions, verifies its identity, and registers every output.

## The five stages

1. **Register** — `agent-boarding-pass` (boarding pass / onboarding).
2. **Remember** — `agent-memory-keeper`, `session-continuity-protocol`,
   `context-engineering` (long-term memory, cross-session continuity, context budget).
3. **Verify** — `verified-agent-identity` (flagship, anti-drift identity card),
   `agent-loop-guard` (loop safety).
4. **Output** — `agent-output-registry` (every output registered & traceable).
5. **Evolve** — `agent-evolution` (writes improvements back to memory).

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/whois-agent
cd whois-agent
bash install.sh        # or: powershell -File install.ps1
```

Or per-agent:

```bash
claude plugin install whois-agent@claude-plugins   # Claude Code
cp -r . ~/.codex/whois-agent                       # Codex
cp -r . ~/.cursor/whois-agent                      # Cursor
```

## Trigger words

who is my agent / cross-session memory / verified identity card / anti-drift /
output registry / session continuity / context budget / agent memory lifecycle /
跨会话记忆 / 身份核验 / 产出留痕.

## Boundaries

- This repo is an orchestration/collection layer; sub-skill implementations live in
  their own packages and carry their own licenses.
- No sub-package implementation is vendored or modified here.
